notes: Fresh Sep 10 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 161 judge candidates. Every row was reviewed for entity accuracy and all five B_V1 components. Accidental/common-token ticker mappings, evergreen/prediction content, weak evidence, low-materiality general-interest items and duplicate angles were hard-rejected. Eight distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding.

events.event_title: TSMC Reports Record August Revenue Amid Strong AI Chip Demand

evidence.title: TSMC August Revenue Rises 53.3% to T$514.8 Billion
Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) Reports 53.3% Revenue Growth Amid AI Demand

events.judge_reason: Record August revenue with 53% year-on-year growth is a fresh, highly material AI-foundry demand signal for TSMC and its U.S.-listed semiconductor customers.
events.verification_note: Use TSMC monthly revenue disclosure for the exact August and year-to-date figures.
